welcome: On behalf of the Organizing Committee, it is my great pleasure to invite you to the 14th Asian-Pacific Conference on Biomechanics (14th APBiomech), to be held in Bali, Indonesia, on November 16-19, 2027. Hosted by the Faculty of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Institut Teknologi Bandung, under the auspices of the Asian-Pacific Association for Biomechanics (APAB), this will be the first time the APBiomech series is held in Indonesia.
Beyond the scientific programme, we hope you will take time to enjoy Bali's rich culture, natural beauty, and warm hospitality.
Sampai jumpa di Bali. We look forward to seeing you there.
